prompt:
A Binary Search Tree (BST) is constructed by sequentially inserting the following keys into an initially empty tree:
`[38, 19, 57, 10, 29, 47, 67]`

What is the exact **Inorder** traversal sequence of this tree?
explanation: Inorder traversal visits Left Subtree -> Root -> Right Subtree. For any valid BST, an Inorder traversal always yields the keys in ascending sorted order: [10, 19, 29, 38, 47, 57, 67].
